claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back to Earth.
The mission goal of the Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed lunar flyby test mission.
The crew of the Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman (NASA), Victor Glover (NASA), Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
The launch vehicle for the Artemis II mission is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis III is a crew landing mission.
